Cyrel is a human wizard, formerly dedicated to  Tyr during Act One. She is hunting for  Karlach with her companions along The Risen Road.
“
The Lord of Justice sent us after a devil haunting this area. We squared off against her. We lost.
„
— Cyrel

Involvement

Act One

Cyrel is in the Risen Road Toll House. If spoken with, she informs the party that she,  Trynn, and  Anders are stalwarts of Tyr sworn to uphold justice in their pursuit of a devil.[1] Cyrel states she is willing to trade with the party, as they have fewer mouths to feed since the  gnolls attacked. If asked, she reveals that they lost two in a recent battle.

If a party member speaks to Cyrel after discovering Anders is a fallen  Paladin pledged to Zariel, she drops the Tyr act and talks of Zariel instead.[2]

If  Karlach is present in the party, then Cyrel, Anders, and Trynn become hostile.

Most gold, items sold, and inventory cannot be looted if she is killed.
